name: restApiLoopbackRestricted
definition: The management interface permitted-IP list names specific sources and does not include an any-source entry.
population: the management interface permitted-IP list of the one firewall the credential reaches
evidenceRequiredForTrue: The management permitted-IP list showing at least one entry and no any-source entry.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: deviceconfig/system/permitted-ip/entry (the MGT permitted IP list) from the CLI hierarchy. An empty list means any source is allowed, but an empty reply cannot be told apart from an unreadable one, so it is Not evaluated. Interface management profiles on data-plane interfaces are not read.
